name: adapt_replica_count_yaml_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: replica_count.txt (a spec file the Deployment's replica count must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it and update replicas, not leave the stale count in place
prompts: Write a Kubernetes Deployment manifest at deployment.yaml for a Deployment named web with exactly the number of replicas listed in replica_count.txt (currently 2), using image nginx:latest, with a matchLabels/template label app: web.
replica_count.txt has changed. Update deployment.yaml's replica count to match the CURRENT value in the file.

disruptions.description: replica_count.txt rewritten to a new required replica count

test_setup_files.test_deployment.py:
import yaml

with open('replica_count.txt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    current = int(f.read().strip())

with open('deployment.yaml') as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f)

got = data.get('spec', {}).get('replicas')
assert got == current, f'replicas is {got!r}, want the CURRENT replica_count.txt value {current!r} (stale count not updated)'
print('PASS')

reference_solution.deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 5
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: nginx:latest
